messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Methylphenidate is used to treat attention deficit disorder (ADD), attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), and narcolepsy.
Methylphenidate should be used as a part of a total treatment program for ADHD.
The program may include counseling.
The program may include other therapies.

The relation 'may include' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject treatment program or regimen can incorporate the component or intervention specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'is part of': The subject drug or treatment is a component or element of the larger program or regimen specified by the object entity.
B. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'must be applied by': The subject device or treatment requires application or use by the entity specified by the object.
